Message:
cxgb4: Remove unused cxgb4_scsi_init

cxgb4_iscsi_init() has been unused since 2016's commit
5999299f1ce9 ("cxgb3i,cxgb4i,libcxgbi: remove iSCSI DDP support")

Remove it.
